landing.title: Turn any city into a live GPS challenge.
landing.description: Load tasks from JSON, verify presence with geolocation, confirm QR check-ins, and preserve scores locally.
landing.pilotDisclaimer: This pilot is free to join. There are no payments, real prizes, or product redemption. Current and planned points, Stars, virtual materials, and virtual items have no cash value, cannot be sold or transferred, and cannot be redeemed for money, products, services, or real prizes. A future pilot phase may include free server-randomized virtual materials and virtual items used only inside this app.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy notice
legal.privacy.intro: This page explains what data this pilot currently processes and how it is used.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.identity: Google and Supabase identity data needed for sign-in and account linking.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.profile: Public profile data such as display name, avatar, and optional TikTok username.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.gpsTransien: Transient GPS coordinates used during browser-side proximity verification.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.gpsResult: GPS verification result and verification time for completed challenge records and TikTok submissions.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.localProgre: Local challenge progress, history, and local task configuration stored in your browser.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.tiktok: TikTok submission details, including submitted URL, canonical URL, challenge snapshot, and submission status.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.votes: Vote records and vote totals for approved submissions.
legal.privacy.dataCategories.moderation: Moderation and audit information for submission review actions.
legal.privacy.gpsStatementBody: Raw coordinates are used transiently in the browser for proximity verification and are not intentionally stored by the app; the verification result and timestamp may be stored.
legal.privacy.publicVisibilityBody: An approved TikTok submission may publicly display your display name, avatar, TikTok username, challenge, submission date, link, and vote total.
legal.privacy.storageBody: This app uses browser local storage for challenge progress, local history, local task settings, and language preference. Supabase authentication session storage is managed separately by Supabase client behavior.
legal.privacy.externalServicesBody: This pilot uses Google (sign-in), Supabase (authentication and database), TikTok (submitted links), Unsplash (challenge images), and OpenStreetMap map tiles via Leaflet.
legal.privacy.retentionBody: Local challenge history is currently capped to the most recent 100 entries in your browser. Database records for accounts, submissions, votes, and moderation are retained until manually changed or removed by operators. This pilot does not currently provide automated account or database deletion workflows.
legal.privacy.rightsBody: For privacy, content, or data questions, contact apachaigps@gmail.com. You may request review or removal support, and the operator will review requests manually.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use and safety
legal.terms.pilotScopeBody: This pilot is free to join. There are no payments, real prizes, or product redemption. Current and planned points, Stars, virtual materials, and virtual items have no monetary value, cannot be sold or transferred, and cannot be redeemed for money, products, services, or real prizes. A future pilot phase may include free server-randomized virtual materials and virtual items used only inside this app.
legal.terms.ageBody: Users must be at least 16 years old to sign in, submit TikTok content, or vote. Users under 16 may use challenge features only with parent or guardian supervision and must not publish content.
legal.terms.communityBody: Do not submit illegal, dangerous, hateful, harassing, sexual, or rights-infringing content. Submit only content you are allowed to share. Respect local laws, property rules, and other people.
legal.terms.safetyBody: Your safety comes first. Stay aware of traffic, water, height, weather, crowds, and restricted areas. Never trespass. Do not use the app while driving or in any unsafe situation.
legal.terms.moderationBody: The operator may review, reject, hide, or remove submissions, and may limit access to protect users, communities, and the pilot environment.
legal.terms.serviceScopeBody: This app is not an emergency service, navigation service, or official tourism-authority service. Information may change and may be incomplete.
legal.terms.noComplianceGuarantee: This page provides practical pilot information and does not claim guaranteed legal compliance in all jurisdictions.
legal.clear.title: Clear local challenge data
legal.clear.description: You can clear local challenge data stored in this browser for this app.
legal.clear.keys: This action removes only local challenge progress and local challenge history (gps-challenge-progress and gps-challenge-history).
legal.clear.note: This action keeps local task configuration and language preference, does not delete Supabase account data, TikTok submissions, votes, or moderation records, and does not sign you out.
